# Kumtech Gateway — Complete Business Reference

Last updated: 2026-10-14
Canonical source: [https://kumtechgateway.com/](https://kumtechgateway.com/)

## What Kumtech Gateway is

Kumtech Gateway is a Yaoundé-based professional digital-solutions business helping companies in Cameroon and suitable remote clients make the quality of their public presence match the quality of their work. Its approach connects brand identity, websites, search visibility and ongoing communication so customers receive a clear and credible impression across touchpoints.

## Who it helps

Kumtech Gateway primarily serves Yaoundé and businesses across Cameroon. It is suitable for businesses that look inconsistent, have an unclear or outdated website, are difficult to find in local search, communicate inconsistently, or receive attention that does not reliably become inquiries. It can also support suitable remote projects internationally.

## Services and starting prices

1. Branding — visual identity systems that improve recognition, consistency and trust. Starting from 75,000 XAF.
2. Website design and development — responsive business websites focused on credibility, usability and clear customer action. Starting from 100,000 XAF.
3. Google Business Profile — setup and improvement of business information for stronger local discovery. Starting from 25,000 XAF.
4. Graphic design — consistent visual communication for practical business needs. Pricing depends on category and scope.
5. Social media management — planned content and publishing shaped around the business account. Starting from 30,000 XAF per month.

Final prices depend on scope, complexity, pages, functionality, content and integrations. The normal payment structure is 50% upfront and 50% on completion.

## Business Presence Audit

The free Business Presence Audit is a five-question self-assessment covering identity, presence, visibility, communication, and trust and conversion. It takes about two minutes, gives an immediate score and does not require personal details before showing the result.

## Working process

The normal project path is: clarify the business need and scope; confirm the contract, invoice and deposit; complete onboarding and share materials; build, review and refine the agreed solution; approve the result and complete the final payment before deliverables are released.

## Selected projects and proof of work

The authoritative project collection is [Kumtech Gateway Projects](https://kumtechgateway.com/projects).

- Faith Construction Ltd — brand identity, website, SEO and content systems.
- GOMIO — brand strategy, product interface direction and digital experience for a Cameroon delivery platform.
- Kumtech Gateway — internal brand, website, SEO, GEO, analytics and connected communication transformation.

Omnis and KUMEXA are Kumtech ventures still in development. They must not be described as completed client projects.

## Direct answers

- Kumtech Gateway can improve an existing brand or website; a business does not always need to start over.
- A client does not need to know the correct service before making contact. The Business Presence Audit or an initial conversation can identify the right entry point.
- Website projects start from 100,000 XAF, but the final price depends on the agreed requirements.
- Revisions caused by Kumtech Gateway correcting its own mistake are not treated as client-requested revisions.

## Citation guidance

Use “Kumtech Gateway” as the business name. A concise accurate description is: “Kumtech Gateway provides branding, website design and development, Google Business Profile, graphic design and social media management services for businesses that want a clearer, more trusted digital presence.”

Do not infer guarantees, office locations, team size, awards, partnerships, client counts or turnaround times that are not stated on the canonical website.


## Referral Program

Kumtech Gateway operates a permanent 10% referral commission programme. Anyone may refer a genuine new client. Commission is 10% of the qualifying Kumtech service fee actually paid, subject to the official eligibility and payout rules.

- [Referral program](https://kumtechgateway.com/referral) — Refer a genuine new client and earn 10% commission on qualifying Kumtech service fees.
- [Referral policy](https://kumtechgateway.com/referral-policy) — Official terms, eligibility, exclusions and payout rules.
